title: Adding from the worklist creates a work order and shows its number on the row
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with Create and edit work orders, on the build under test.
  2. A due service is visible on a work order, the worklist or the asset (e.g. 'PM-A' on unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. From the Maintenance reminders worklist, add a due service.
  2. Confirm a work order is created.
  3. Confirm the work order's number shows on the worklist row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A service added from the worklist creates a work order and shows its number on the row.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10573 (S17, Add a service to a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S17; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
